summary: All 5 first-pass findings confirmed at their original severities (1 blocker, 1 major, 3 minor); none refuted, none uncertain. The 24.1 blocker is real and fully reproduced: frozen targets put +4/9 in the middle cell of every test (u(0)=+1) while the prompt assigns x=0 to the sin(x)-1 branch (u(0)=-1), and pass/fail additionally hinges on last-bit rounding of the Gauss node at the discontinuity — prompt-faithful, exact-analytic, and textbook-affine-map implementations all FAIL official scoring. One small evidence correction: the faithful impl passes the n_x=100 test in isolation (node rounds to +1.11e-16), though the official joint verdict is FAIL either way. The problem is fixable to fair with modest effort: a single test_edit (24.1 n_x 10/100/30 -> 11/101/31 + regenerating three targets, recipe and values provided) repairs both 24.1 findings at once; the remaining three are one-line prompt/doc edits with no target changes.
